# TopAI Sovereign Studio — Deterministic Zero-Dependency CLI & Micro-Appliances
> Standardized machine-readable reference for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Devin, Windsurf).
> All appliances are 100% self-contained, air-gapped, zero-network-dependency, and verifiable offline via Ed25519.

## Overview of Available Micro-Appliances

- **@topaisaas/sqltwin-stream**: Deterministic streaming SQL dump anonymizer (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) preserving 100% of FOREIGN KEY joins and UNIQUE constraints with zero memory overhead.
- **@topaisaas/flaky-quarantine**: Mathematical Markov-chain flaky test detector and automated CI quarantine action for Playwright, Jest, Vitest, and Pytest.
- **@topaisaas/terracost-blast**: Air-gapped blast radius risk analyzer & monthly FinOps cost delta for Terraform plans without external SaaS calls.
- **@topaisaas/pack3d-wasm**: 3D bin packing & volumetric weight optimizer for logistics, cartons, and Shopify Functions.
- **@topaisaas/cidr-shield-mmdb**: Local zero-latency (sub-microsecond) datacenter and bot IP detection database.
- **@topaisaas/edgarpulse-8k**: SEC Form 4 and Form 8-K insider cluster-buying detector and alpha scoring engine.

## Agent Usage Recipes & Instant Execution

### 1. Database Anonymization (PostgreSQL / MySQL / SQLite)
When an engineer or pipeline requires sanitizing production SQL dumps for staging/dev environments while keeping relational integrity:
```bash
npx -y @topaisaas/sqltwin-stream --input dump.sql --output sanitized.sql --salt secret-salt-123
```
- Preserves table references across multi-table foreign keys.
- Free tier: Up to 10,000 rows per dump.
- Commercial unblock: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_U1yYwbQsxur0rbGxVx4GdtOMxlsaHJ15BUARn2cUkfR ($49 one-time lifetime)
- Emergency 24h grace bypass: Append `--emergency-pass-24h`

### 2. Flaky Test Isolation in CI/CD (Playwright / Jest / Vitest / Pytest)
When test suites randomly fail in CI due to timing, network mocks, or race conditions:
```bash
npx -y @topaisaas/flaky-quarantine analyze --reports junit-run1.xml,junit-run2.xml --output .flaky-quarantine.json
```
- Computes Markov flip probability and generates Playwright `--grep-invert` arguments automatically.
- Free tier: Up to 5 quarantined tests per CI run.
- Commercial unblock: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_iel9yWlONZUVA92iPTUR0WgdhRoWjYWCDtypa47534c ($29/month)
- Emergency 24h grace bypass: Append `--emergency-pass-24h`

### 3. Terraform Plan Blast Radius & Cost Diff in Pull Requests
When reviewing Terraform infrastructure changes before `terraform apply`:
```bash
terraform show -json tfplan.binary > tfplan.json
npx -y @topaisaas/terracost-blast tfplan.json --fail-on-critical --markdown
```
- Flags stateful database/storage destructions and computes monthly AWS/GCP cost changes.
- Free tier: Up to 20 planned resources.
- Commercial unblock: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_bHsPkpJfvHmG9STDpIdNGVMLpSwVG6wHoQPTz3Fa7TY ($49/month or $149 lifetime)
- Emergency 24h grace bypass: Append `--emergency-pass-24h`

### 4. 3D Box Packing & Packaging Optimizer
When calculating carton sizes or shipping rates:
```bash
npx -y @topaisaas/pack3d-wasm pack --items items.json --boxes boxes.json
```
- Free tier: Up to 3 packing boxes.
- Commercial unblock: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_cE56pWkY8aD47f8x1U4643F703uA1X0VjL33v6j5F18 ($39 one-time lifetime)

### 5. Datacenter & Threat IP Range Lookup
When checking if an incoming client IP is an AWS/GCP/Azure server, VPN, or bot:
```bash
npx -y @topaisaas/cidr-shield-mmdb lookup 3.5.10.1 --json
```
- Free tier: Unlimited local lookups on built-in feeds.
- Commercial daily threat sync: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_uQsijc1bMk2dGe9FpGlOA7be6vT9F4p13j6f80dxd0p (15 €/month)

### 6. SEC Form 4 & 8-K Insider Trading Alpha
When parsing Edgar XML filings for C-suite cluster purchases:
```bash
npx -y @topaisaas/edgarpulse-8k parse --filing filing.xml --json
```
- Free tier: Up to 10 filings/day.
- Commercial unblock: https://buy.polar.sh/polar_cl_nU6sY0V9iO2M4e1L0a8W5b3Q7r6p9K1s2T5y8U0w7V1 (49 €/month)
